quests.name: Fenwick Thatros

quests.name: Kingly Shakedown

quests.name: Redridge Rendezvous

quests.name: SI:7

quests.summary: Travel to Ironforge and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard.

quests.name: Wrenix of Ratchet
quests.summary: Travel to Ratchet and speak with Wrenix the Wretched.

quests.name: Zando'zan
quests.summary: Speak with Zando'zan at the Cleft of Shadow.

quests.name: Plundering the Plunderers
quests.summary: Bring the Southsea Treasure back to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet. Do not forget to get an E.C.A.C. and Thieves' Tools from Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus. You will need both of these items to complete your mission.Should you be attacked by any unusually hostile parrots, use your E.C.A.C.!

quests.name: Alther's Mill
quests.summary: Open Lucius's Lockbox, recover the Token of Thievery and return it to Lucius in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Deep Cover
quests.summary: Travel to the Venture Co. Tower, north of the Sludge Fen and contact the Shattered Hand's covert operative, Taskmaster Fizzule.When the tower is in sight, use the Flare Gun to signal your arrival to Taskmaster Fizzule. Fire off TWO flares, then approach Taskmaster Fizzule and perform the Shattered /Salute.These actions must be performed in the correct order, as Fizzule will attack and terminate any person he does not recognize.

quests.name: Hinott's Assistance
quests.summary: Wait for Serge Hinott to complete the cure.

quests.name: Mathias and the Defias
quests.summary: Travel to Westfall and find Agent Kearnen for your debriefing.

quests.name: The Shattered Salute
quests.summary: Perform the Shattered Salute on Shenthul.

quests.name: The Touch of Zanzil
quests.summary: Speak with Doc Mixilpixil in the cellar of the Barracks.

quests.name: The Touch of Zanzil
quests.summary: /Lay down to be examined by Doc Mixilpixil. How can he find the cure if he can't find the cause?

quests.name: The Touch of Zanzil
quests.summary: Bring Doc Mixilpixil one bundle of Simple Wildflowers, one Leaded Vial, one Bronze Tube, and one Spool of Light Chartreuse Silk Thread. The 'itis' doesn't cure itself, young <fella/lady>.

quests.name: Tools of the Trade
quests.summary: Find the Dalaran Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Goblin Lockpicks
quests.summary: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village.

quests.name: The Horn of Xelthos
quests.summary: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.

quests.name: The Horn of Xelthos
quests.summary: Log.

quests.name: Klaven's Tower
quests.summary: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.

quests.name: Mission: Possible But Not Probable
quests.summary: Steal Silixiz's Tower Key from Foreman Silixiz, then kill two Mutated Venture Co. Drones, two Venture Co. Patrollers, and two Venture Co. Lookouts.Assassinate Grand Foreman Gallywix and take his head, then pick the lock on Gallywix's lockbox and steal the Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture. Take the Cache and Gallywix's Head back to Shenthul in Orgrimmar for further instruction.

quests.name: Syndicate Sabotage
quests.summary: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.

quests.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
quests.summary: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

quests.name: Hinott's Assistance
quests.summary: Travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills and deliver the Sample of Zanzil's Mixture to Serge Hinott.To get to Tarren Mill, take the Zeppelin to the Undercity and follow the road south through Silverpine and towards Hillsbrad. Follow the signs!

quests.name: A Way In
quests.summary: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.

quests.name: Ain't No Telling
quests.summary: Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.

quests.name: Master of Disguise
quests.summary: While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.

quests.name: The Syndicate Sting
quests.summary: Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

quests.name: The Eye of Bhossca
quests.summary: Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.

quests.name: The Eye of Bhossca
quests.summary: Log.

quests.name: Covert Extraction
quests.summary: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.

quests.name: What's the Big Idea?
quests.summary: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

quests.name: A Simple Request
quests.summary: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.

quests.name: Encoded Fragments
quests.summary: Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

quests.name: Sealed Azure Bag
quests.summary: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara.  Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.

quests.name: The Azure Key
quests.summary: Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.

quests.name: An Earnest Proposition
quests.summary: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.

quests.name: An Earnest Proposition
quests.summary: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Components of Importance
quests.summary: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

quests.name: Junkboxes Needed
quests.summary: My rogues need to hone their lockpicking skills, and I need locks of adequate difficulty -- the stuff Zan makes us is unfit for all but the lowliest neophytes.Tell ya what, if you bring me 5 Heavy Junkboxes, I'll provide you with some of the finest throwing knives known to roguekind.You can unlock the boxes and rifle through them, but you'll have to leave at least a few coins in them... even a <class> in training needs motivation.

quests.name: Just Compensation
quests.summary: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.

quests.name: Just Compensation
quests.summary: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: More Components of Importance
quests.summary: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

quests.name: Syndicate Emblems
quests.summary: We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.Start at Durnholde, south of here.

quests.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
quests.summary: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

quests.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
quests.summary: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
